create_olmo3_config: create an Olmo3Config instance with default model parameters for a 7B style transformer
init_olmo3_config: initialize an Olmo3Config with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads
inspect_olmo3_tp_plan: inspect the base model tensor parallelism plan for olmo3 attention and mlp layers
inspect_olmo3_pp_plan: inspect the base model pipeline parallelism plan for olmo3 embed_tokens, layers, and norm
resolve_olmo3_defaults: resolve Olmo3Config defaults for num_key_value_heads and layer_types via __post_init__
